items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I used to see him, but I never paid any attention.

ctx.x: All that side. Do you know how old man Papa Teo played? How did he hold his lip first? Same way. Yeah, I didn't listen with him too. And what about Big Eye? Do you remember how Big Eye played? Big Eye? Really?

I used to see him, but I never paid any attention. Big Eye, they used to play a little on the side like that. Just a little bit. Did he bite, put his teeth on the mouthpiece? Yeah, he bit down on the mouthpiece. He bit. Mm-hmm.
